relationships.subject: HIF-1α
relationships.evidence_quote: HIF-1α also increases the expression of important glycolytic enzymes, including HK2, PFK, PDK1, and LDHA [44].

relationships.subject: PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: activation of PI3K induces downstream phosphorylation of AKT and activation of mTORC1, which, in turn, enhances HIF1A expression and glycolytic enzyme activity.

relationships.subject: dichloroacetate
relationships.evidence_quote: DCA was shown to restore mitochondrial function by inhibiting PDK1, reduce lactic acid production, and alleviate endometriosis-related pain [99,100,101].

key_findings: Review: Warburg-like glycolytic reprogramming in endometriosis is driven by hypoxia/HIF-1α, PI3K/AKT/mTOR and inflammatory cytokine signaling (NF-κB, STAT3).
PDK inhibition (dichloroacetate) is a leading metabolic therapeutic strategy that alleviates endometriosis-related pain.
